messages.author: f65427d526ca30b4
messages.subject: stan hashtag
parts: Let me head you off: I don't intend to usurp this focussed, useful group into Twitter, but I use both. It seems stan hashtags have never been used. #stan apparently means Stalker + Fan = Stan (not good), while #mcstan has never been used (could be confused if some rapper of that name comes along) and #rstan is a little R-centric. I'm going to go with #mcstan right now, and if anyone wants to correct me so we get to some consensus, please do!

messages.author: cab04b8f0759c712
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] stan hashtag
parts:
Thanks for the suggestions, but:
- can't do @mc-stan. No hypens allowed. (and mc_stan, mcstan are taken)
- @mcmc_stan isn't really accurate and neither is @hmc_stan. (HMC is an MCMC algorithm. Stan does more than MCMC.) We can change the username to something reasonable. I'm open to suggestions.

I think the mention should work just as well as the hashtag. I'm not sure what's easier to follow on twitter, but I'm guessing both are easy to use? If we adopt a hashtag, I vote for #mc-stan.


Daniel
